disease_definition: Broad diabetes = ICD-10/BNO diagnosis groups E10, E11, E12, E13, E14.
primary_product_message: SPICY CareRisk helps healthcare organizations identify elevated chronic disease risk, plan prevention capacity, validate partner/site data, and report model trust using aggregate, privacy-conscious evidence.
current_limitations_summary: Current collaborative training evidence is based on a synthetic random four-client simulation and should be treated as proof of concept until real partner-site validation and secure production deployment are completed.
